interface.longDescription:
Talk face to face with conversational AI avatars and build your own real-time avatar app. LiveAvatar by HeyGen combines interactive avatar video chat, voice and text conversations, practical role-play, and official developer resources.

Try three avatar conversations without connecting an account:
• Interview practice: Meet Karen for a fictional Burger King job interview and practice answering follow-up questions.
• Business coach: Explore an idea, rehearse your pitch and discuss your next move with Shawn.
• Tough conversations: Practice letting a fictional employee, Rachel, go and finding the right words under pressure.

Watch and listen to the avatar, speak where microphone access is supported, or type your replies. Sessions last up to five minutes. Streaming captions and conversation history help you follow both sides. Open the browser experience for voice when your client does not support microphone capture. After a conversation, share an invitation or explore how to build your own.

Build with official open-source samples:
• Web avatar: Set up an interactive video, voice and text chat app using the JavaScript SDK, with a background-removal example.
• AI sales agent: Build website sales conversations and lead qualification, with optional CRM summaries and team notifications.
• Voice tutor: Explore a speech-to-speech language tutor with an avatar, term cards and lesson recaps.
• Python voice agent: Run a speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis pipeline in a hosted room or a room you control.
• Animated overlays: Explore a sample that turns spoken visual requests into animations alongside an avatar.

Developer workflows help select a sample, prepare a project directory, install locked dependencies, configure backend credentials privately, run startup checks and customize prompts. Local setup requires a supported coding environment. Chat-only clients provide a guided continuation to that environment. A bundled local terminal helper supports hidden API-key entry without placing the key in the conversation. Automatic conversation transfer is not included.

Running a developer sample requires a LiveAvatar account and API key, plus any provider credentials needed by that sample. V1 does not connect your account, read credit balances, create custom avatars or monitor jobs.

Explore the full API documentation, developer portal, JavaScript SDK and sample projects:
API documentation: https://docs.liveavatar.com
Developer portal: https://app.liveavatar.com
Website: https://www.liveavatar.com

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three anonymous avatar conversations and six developer workflows for official sample projects. Includes voice and text interaction, transcripts, sharing, local project setup and private API-key entry guidance. Sample checkouts are pinned to reviewed commits with lockfile-based installs.
